version: LOCK 60 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - side mission: The spilled spice
builds_on: LOCK 34 runner; LOCK 3 and LOCK 6 regulars; River Market places (LOCK 1). Each mission is its own LOCK and queue line.

missions.title: The spilled spice
missions.button: Old Sulayman knocked over a sack

a.text: Old Sulayman, half blind, knocks over a sack of saffron at Rashid's stall and shuffles on without noticing. You are the only one who saw.

b.text: Later, Rashid has Faris the orphan boy by the ear. “You! You were hanging round my stall!” He turns to you. “You were here. Was it him?”

choices.label: Tell the truth: it was Sulayman, by accident

truth.text: Rashid lets go of Faris's ear. He goes to find Sulayman, who is so upset that Rashid ends up comforting him. Faris looks at you like you've given him a coin.

lie.text: Rashid makes Faris sweep his stall for a week. The next day Sulayman comes to apologise for the saffron.

silent.text: Rashid lets Faris go with a cuff and a warning. Faris doesn't come near the spice row for a week.

truth: Spoke up for Faris at the spice row
